SEC. 87001. DATE FOR DETERMINING CONSOLIDATED ASSETS.

    Section 171(b)(4)(C) of the Financial Stability Act of 2010 (12 
U.S.C. 5371(b)(4)(C)) is amended by inserting ``or March 31, 2010,'' 
after ``December 31, 2009,''.
